deliverable: P6 materiality assessment — would the inert max_extension_from_pivot_pct filter have changed anything?

method.prior_high20: reconstructed EXACTLY as src/agents/setup_agent.py::breakout_setup defines it — high.shift(1).rolling(20).max() on the signal-date frame
method.pit_safety: shift(1) excludes the signal bar; only bars <= signal_date and the entry session's open are used
method.applied_to: the trades the system actually took, replayed counterfactually

unavailable_reason: no signal_date / no cached bars / fewer than 21 bars before the signal / missing entry bar

near_miss_within_1pp.note: how sharp the cut is; a large near-miss population would mean the threshold sits inside the distribution

caveats: This reconstructs what the breakout path's pivot WOULD have been for a pullback setup. That is the exact quantity the frozen filter consumes, but it was never computed by the production setup, so the counterfactual is a measurement of the filter's potential effect, not a claim about what Setup v1 'meant'.
The reconstruction uses each trade's own signal date, so the gap and extension are evaluated exactly where the live path would.
